description: Five callers about the same fire at the fixture building Wilshire Tower, 1200 Wilshire Boulevard (fake_wilshire_tower: six stories, ground-floor restaurant), each saying the floor differently: sixth floor, floor six, six floors up counting the restaurant, just under the roof, all the way at the top. All mean floor 6. A sixth call is a different incident (a car on fire on a side street) and must not be merged. Expected: data/fixtures/calls/expected/s10_wilshire.json.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's smoke at 1200 Wilshire Boulevard, the Wilshire Tower. It's on the sixth floor.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Sixth floor of the Wilshire Tower. What do you see?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Gray smoke out of two windows, and I can hear the fire alarm from the sidewalk.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is anyone inside that you know of?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: People are coming out the front lobby, a bunch of them.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Okay. Stay back from the building.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, I'm across the street.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller

segments.text: Are you in the building?

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Did you see anyone still up there?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I heard somebody banging on a door upstairs, I didn't stop, sorry.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, yes, I'm at the restaurant on the ground floor of the Wilshire Tower, the smoke's coming from way up.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Which floor, can you tell?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Let me count. Six floors up, if you count us, the restaurant. So six.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Six floors up counting the restaurant. Thank you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: We're getting everybody out of the dining room now.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Good. Is your kitchen involved?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no, the kitchen's fine, we shut everything off.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's a fire at the tower on Wilshire, the one with the cafe. Up top, right under the roof.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Right under the roof. The highest floor?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, the top windows, just below the roof line. There's orange in one of them now.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: You can see flames?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I think so, yeah, it's flickering. Flames, yeah.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Thank you. Please keep clear of the entrance.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Um, the building on Wilshire is smoking, the tall one by the bus stop?

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Do you know the floor?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I don't know, up at the top, all the way at the top. I don't know the number.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: That's okay. Is anyone hurt?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's an older lady sitting on the curb coughing, she came out of there.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: I'll send medics too. Stay with her if it's safe.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, nobody, it's parked. The hood's on fire, there's flames coming out the front.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is it near any building?

segments.speaker: caller

segments.speaker: call_taker
